title: Series conflict report
description: One row of data/curated/series-conflicts.jsonl for every game whose `MatchSchedule` row names two other teams, and for every series row that every game naming it contradicts. The two states the build acts on are committed here because a build's stdout is not a dataset: without this file, a reader of `data/curated/` cannot tell a series the source contradicted from a series nobody fetched. A `detached-game` row says the game is still emitted (its own data is not in doubt) but carries no canonical `matchId`; a `contradicted-series` row says the series is not emitted at all. `matchId` is the canonical id of the series the row is about, present on both kinds even though a detached game no longer points at it; `sourceGameId`/`sourceMatchId` are the source's own identifiers, so the report can be checked against the payloads. The two team pairs are canonical ids with display names, sorted by id so a side swap cannot move them; the source strings stay on the game and match rows themselves (spec R7).

kind.description: `detached-game`: the game is emitted without a canonical `matchId` because its series row names other teams. `contradicted-series`: the series row is not emitted because every game naming it names other teams.

eventId.description: The selected event both the game and the series belong to; a game and its series cannot sit in different events.

eventName.description: The event's display name, repeated so the row reads without a join.

gameId.description: The canonical id of the detached game, or null on a contradicted-series row (which has no emitted game).

matchId.description: The canonical id of the series the row is about. On a detached-game row this id is deliberately absent from the game record; on a contradicted-series row it is absent from matches.jsonl.

sourceGameId.description: The source `GameId` of the detached game, verbatim; null on a contradicted-series row.

sourceMatchId.description: The source `MatchId` of the series row, verbatim, so the row can be found in the recorded `MatchSchedule` payload.

gameTeams.description: The detached game's two canonical teams, sorted by `teamId`; null on a contradicted-series row.

teamName.description: The team's display name, so the pair reads without a join.

matchTeams.description: The series row's two canonical teams, sorted by `teamId` — the pair the game's own teams disagree with.

teamName.description: The team's display name, so the pair reads without a join.
